title: Droplet-based Single-cell Joint Profiling of Histone Modification and Transcriptome
author: YANG Xie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-2310/v1
materials: 1.1 µL Template Switch Oligo (10X Genomics PN-
1.9 µL Reducing Agent B (10X Genomics PN-
7.5 µL Barcoding Enzyme Mix (10X Genomics PN-2000266)

After droplet generation completed, aspirate 100 µl emulsions (nuclei-encapsulating droplets) into a new PCR tube. Incubated in a Bio-Rad T100 thermal cycler with following program, with lid temperature set to 50 °C: (Reverse transcription as well as cell barcoding complete during the incubation.) 37 °C 45mins 25 °C 30mins hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Prepare OMNI nuclei lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 693.75 µL ATAC‑RSB buffer, 3.75 µL Digitonin (2 %), 7.5 µL IGEPAL‑CA630 (10 %), 7.5 µL Tween‑20 (10 %), 15 µL SUPERaseIN, 7.5 µL RNaseOUT, and 15 µL 50X PI to make the OMNI nuclei lysis buffer.

steps.title: Prepare high‑salt MED1 buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 20 µL HEPES (pH 7.5, 1 M), 54.2 µL NaCl (5 M), 0.5 µL Spermidine (1 M), 20 µL 50X PI, 50 µL SUPERaseIN, 25 µL RNaseOUT, 1 µL IGEPAL‑CA630 (10 %), 5 µL Digitonin (2 %), 4 µL EDTA (500 mM), 200 µL 10 % BSA, and 620.3 µL H₂O to obtain MED1 buffer (RNase inhibitor concentration doubled).

steps.title: Assemble antibody‑pA‑Tn5 conjugate
steps.instruction: Mix 1 µg rabbit polyclonal antibody against the target histone modification with 1 µL assembled pA‑Tn5 (0.4 mg/mL) in 50 µL MED1 buffer.

steps.title: Incubate conjugation mixture
steps.instruction: Rotate the antibody‑pA‑Tn5 mixture for 1 hour at room temperature to allow conjugation.

steps.title: Disassociate cells for nuclei isolation
steps.instruction: Disassociate cells according to the culture protocol; use 0.25–1 million cells per experiment.

steps.title: Lyse cells and isolate nuclei
steps.instruction: Spin down cells at 300 RCF for 5 min, wash once with PBS, spin down again, resuspend in 750 µL OMNI buffer (for ≤5 million cells / 1 mL lysis buffer), and sit on ice for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Spin down cells at 300 RCF for 5 min.
Wash cells once with PBS.
Spin down again.
Resuspend in 750 µL OMNI buffer.
Incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei in MED1 and count
steps.instruction: Spin down nuclei at 1,000 RCF for 10 min at 4 °C, resuspend in 100 µL MED1 buffer, and count nuclei using a cell counter.

steps.title: Aliquot nuclei and resuspend in MED1
steps.instruction: Aliquot 0.25–0.5 million nuclei into Maximum Recovery tubes, spin down at 1,000 RCF for 10 min at 4 °C, and resuspend in 25 µL MED1 buffer.

steps.title: Incubate nuclei with antibody‑pA‑Tn5 overnight
steps.instruction: Add MED1 buffer containing the conjugated antibody‑pA‑Tn5 to each tube and rotate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare MED2 washing buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 20 µL HEPES (pH 7.5, 1 M), 54.2 µL NaCl (5 M), 0.5 µL spermidine (1 M), 20 µL 50X PI, 50 µL SUPERaseIN, 25 µL RNaseOUT, 1 µL IGEPAL‑CA630 (10 %), 5 µL digitonin (2 %), 200 µL 10 % BSA, and 699.3 µL H₂O to make MED2 buffer.

steps.title: Prepare PBS with RNase inhibitors
steps.instruction: Mix 20 µL 50X PI, 25 µL SUPERaseIN, 12.5 µL RNaseOUT, and 942.5 µL 1X PBS to obtain PBS + RI washing solution.

steps.title: Prepare 1X Nuclei buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 5 µL 20X Nuclei Buffer (10X Genomics PN‑2000207), 1 µL DTT (100 mM), 5 µL SUPERaseIN, 2.5 µL RNaseOUT, and 86.5 µL H₂O to make 1X Nuclei buffer.

steps.title: Wash nuclei with MED2 buffer
steps.instruction: Spin down nuclei at 300 RCF for 10 min at 4 °C, wash with 50 µL MED2 buffer, and repeat the wash two additional times (total three washes).

substeps.instruction: Spin down nuclei at 300 RCF for 10 min at 4 °C.
Wash with 50 µL MED2 buffer.
Repeat wash two more times.

steps.title: Tagment nuclei and thaw reagents
steps.instruction: Resuspend washed nuclei in 50 µL MED2 buffer, add 2 µL 250 mM MgCl₂, rotate in a ThermoMixer at 550 rpm, 37 °C for 1 hour; during this incubation thaw 10X Genomics Single Cell Multiome ATAC + GEX Gel Beads and barcoding reagents at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in 50 µL MED2 buffer.
Add 2 µL 250 mM MgCl₂.
Rotate at 550 rpm, 37 °C for 1 hour.
Thaw ATAC + GEX Gel Beads and barcoding reagents at room temperature.

steps.title: Terminate tagmentation and wash nuclei
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL 2X Stop Solution, mix well, spin down nuclei at 500 RCF for 6 min at 4 °C, and wash once with PBS + RI.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL 2X Stop Solution and mix.
Spin down at 500 RCF for 6 min at 4 °C.
Wash once with PBS + RI.

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei for droplet loading
steps.instruction: Spin down nuclei at 500 RCF for 6 min at 4 °C, resuspend in 20 µL 1X Nuclei buffer, count nuclei, aliquot 10–16 k nuclei into a PCR tube, and bring the volume to 8 µL with additional 1X Nuclei buffer.

substeps.instruction: Spin down nuclei at 500 RCF for 6 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend in 20 µL 1X Nuclei buffer.
Count nuclei.
Aliquot 10–16 k nuclei into a PCR tube.
Add 1X Nuclei buffer to reach a final volume of 8 µL.

steps.title: Mix nuclei with ATAC Buffer B
steps.instruction: Add 7 µL ATAC Buffer B (10X Genomics PN‑2000193) to the aliquoted nuclei and proceed directly to droplet generation.

steps.title: Prepare RT and barcoding master mix
steps.instruction: Combine 49.5 µL Barcoding Reagent Mix (PN‑2000267), 1.1 µL Template Switch Oligo (PN‑3000228), 1.9 µL Reducing Agent B (PN‑2000087), and 7.5 µL Barcoding Enzyme Mix (PN‑2000266) to make the reverse‑transcription and cell‑barcoding master mix.

steps.title: Generate droplets and barcode nuclei
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL master mix to the 15 µL nuclei mixture, load the combined sample onto a Chromium Next GEM Chip J, and perform droplet generation with the ChromiumX microfluidics system following the 10X Multiome user guide (CG000338).

substeps.instruction: Add 60 µL master mix to 15 µL nuclei mixture.
Load onto Chromium Next GEM Chip J.
Generate droplets using ChromiumX system per 10X Multiome guide.

steps.title: Quench reaction and proceed to cleanup
steps.instruction: After incubation, add 5 µL Quenching Agent (PN‑2000269) to stop the reaction, mix slowly, and move to product cleanup.

steps.title: Cleanup products with Dynabeads/SPRI
steps.instruction: Perform product cleanup using Dynabeads and SPRI beads exactly as described in the 10X Multiome user guide (CG000338).

steps.title: Pre‑amplify libraries with modified elution
steps.instruction: Carry out pre‑amplification as in the 10X Multiome guide; after the SPRI‑bead cleanup, elute the sample in 80 µL (instead of 160 µL). Pre‑amplified products may be stored at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare DNA and RNA libraries
steps.instruction: For DNA library preparation, use 40 µL purified product; for RNA library preparation, mix 17.5 µL purified product with 17.5 µL H₂O to match the input volume, then follow the 10X Multiome library‑preparation protocol.

steps.title: Sequence DNA library on NextSeq2000
steps.instruction: Sequence DNA libraries on an Illumina NextSeq2000 using the 200‑cycle kit (Illumina #20046812) with read configuration 100 + 8 + 24 + 100 cycles (Read 1 = 100, Index 1 = 8, Index 2 = 24, Read 2 = 100); Index 2 contains cellular barcodes.

steps.title: Sequence RNA library on NextSeq2000
steps.instruction: Sequence RNA libraries on an Illumina NextSeq2000 using the 100‑cycle kit (Illumina #20046811) with read configuration 28 + 10 + 10 + 72 cycles (Read 1 = 28, Index 1 = 10, Index 2 = 10, Read 2 = 72); Read 1 contains cellular barcodes.

steps.title: Demultiplex and analyze sequencing data
steps.instruction: Demultiplex raw sequencing data with cellranger‑arc mkfastq (10X Genomics) and analyse the resulting files using the in‑house pipeline.
